summary.text: J.D. Prescott is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 33, has served since 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: J.D. Prescott, whose full name Ballotpedia gives as John Prescott, assumed office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2018, succeeding Greg Beumer.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026, and in the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat John E. Bartlett.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Elections and Apportionment, House Judiciary, and Ways and Means committees.
